scope: One mathematical diagnostic only; N-only odd inputs without composite, semiprime or hard-factor promises. No factorer, smoothness sample, field-admissibility claim, all-input geometry claim, population-frequency inference or verified factoring complexity improvement.

input_rule.generator: Python stdlib random.Random(1919), one persistent RNG, exactly four getrandbits calls in listed order
input_rule.worker_boundary: One JSON object containing N_hex only. Degree is derived from N.bit_length by the frozen public map. Output paths and wall caps are public runner data. No factors or instance-selection advice.
input_rule.archive: Every generated N is stored in inputs.json and its N-only worker JSON before the immutable freeze manifest is written. Input-generation elapsed work is part of the 55 second wave.

base_and_heights.m: floor(N^(1/d)); integer Newton starts at 2^ceil(bit_length(N)/d), monotonically descends, then corrects using exact powers
base_and_heights.f: ordinary ascending nonnegative base-m digits, verified actual degree d, leading coefficient 1, digits in [0,m), f(m)=N, and m^d <= N < (m+1)^d
base_and_heights.hstar: ceil fifth root of H^4; verify (hstar-1)^5 < H^4 <= hstar^5
base_and_heights.domain_failure: unknown; keep N and d fixed

squarefree.prime_verification: Reference trial divides 65537 by every integer from 2 through isqrt(65537)=256, exactly once in outer setup after source/input freeze; all remainders archived.
squarefree.candidate: Polynomial extended Euclidean algorithm modulo 65537 gives s*f+t*f'=1. Monicity and prime modulus imply square-free over Q.
squarefree.reference: Independently convolve Bezout polynomials with f and f' and reduce modulo 65537, checking constant 1 and every higher coefficient 0; if candidate modular gcd is nonunit independently compute modular gcd.
squarefree.failure: unknown, with no second modulus and no square-free-part substitution

global_count.predicate: f[d-2]*R^(d-2) > sum_(j != d-2) f[j]*R^j, exact integers
global_count.meaning: Exactly d-2 roots inside R and two outside, no roots on the circle. All d-2 inside roots must also be covered by distinct certified one-root disks. This accounts for all d roots without locating the two exterior roots.

approximation.polynomial: degree-(d-2) truncation f[0:d-1] only for proposing centers; exact verification always uses full f
approximation.normalization: Each integer coefficient divided by the maximum absolute coefficient using Python int/int true division before any direct floating conversion of an integer
approximation.arithmetic: Python binary64 complex arithmetic, one deterministic simultaneous Aberth-Ehrlich iteration
approximation.cauchy_radius: 1 + max_(j<k) abs(a[j]/a[k]), k=d-2, a normalized coefficients
approximation.update: Evaluate p and p' by complex Horner; Newton n_i=p(z_i)/p'(z_i); correction n_i/(1-n_i*sum_(j!=i)1/(z_i-z_j)). Compute every correction from the OLD vector, then subtract all corrections simultaneously.
approximation.stop: Every correction modulus <= 2^-42 after a simultaneous sweep
approximation.failure: Any collision, zero derivative or Aberth denominator, nonfinite value, arithmetic exception, or failure to converge yields unknown. No retries, alternative starts, precision, radius or methods.
approximation.rationalization: Python round(real*2^40), round(imag*2^40), nearest with ties to even, numerator integers over Q=2^40

exact_disks.candidate_taylor: Integer Gaussian Horner shifting. At extension level l, new[j]=(x+iy)*old[j]+Q*old[j-1], missing terms zero; new[0] additionally adds f_i*Q^l. Final coefficients A_j=Q^d f^(j)(z)/j!.
exact_disks.reference_taylor: Direct binomial formula A_j=sum_(i=j)^d f_i*binom(i,j)*(x+iy)^(i-j)*Q^(d-i+j), precomputed Gaussian powers. No candidate Taylor or predicate helper is imported/called.
exact_disks.predicate: max(abs(Re A_1),abs(Im A_1))*2^(24*(d-1)) > sum_(j!=1)(abs(Re A_j)+abs(Im A_j))*2^(24*(d-j)). Strict inequality proves exactly one full-f root.
exact_disks.disjointness: Squared coordinate distance > (2*65536)^2 in numerator units for each pair
exact_disks.containment: R*Q > 65536 and x^2+y^2 < (R*Q-65536)^2 for each inside disk
exact_disks.failure: unknown, not root absence or positive supply
exact_disks.evidence: All rational disks; Taylor SHA-256 over hex(real),hex(imag) newline for each A_j; exact disk comparison lhs/rhs hex, bit lengths and hashes

geometry_and_count.pair_lower: L_ij/(U_i*U_j), all pairs archived as exact reduced rational numbers
geometry_and_count.kappa_cert: (1/6)*min_(i<j<l) L_ij*L_il*L_jl/(U_i^2*U_j^2*U_l^2), positive, reduced exact rational x/y; ties retain first lexicographic triple
geometry_and_count.candidate_geometry: Compare integer rational cross-products for all pairs/triples and reduce selected minimum by gcd
geometry_and_count.reference_geometry: Independently reconstruct rational coordinates/U/L and all pair/triple fractions using Fraction
geometry_and_count.equality: Accepted in equation 11; disk and global Rouche predicates remain strictly greater
geometry_and_count.reference_comparison: Recompute using separate x^E and hstar^E factors and separately expanded 20736,2,12,d+1 factors; H power implemented by its exact binary shift
geometry_and_count.primitive_upper_count: (hstar-1)*(2*hstar-1)^2+k, computed only as a theorem witness when prerequisites and equation 11 pass independent verification
geometry_and_count.population: Genuine quadratics aX^2+bX+c with 1<=a<=H, |b|,|c|<=H, primitive and irreducible over Q, satisfying |Res(f,g)|^(5d)*N^9 <= [(3H)^d*(d+1)*A^2]^(5d), A=max f_i
geometry_and_count.qualifications: No irreducibility of f asserted; square-free reducible f permitted for count. Reducibles, contents, zero norms and square-class parity remain separate as in H017. No numeric all-output bound from an unspecified O constant. H016 processing and H018 corrected degree model separate. Heuristic smoothness comparisons imply no useful supply, rank or factoring theorem.

controls.center_generation_before_freeze: Q=2^40. Let a=isqrt(2*Q^2); increment a iff 8*Q^2 > (2*a+1)^2, obtaining nearest integer to sqrt(2)*Q. Expanded integer centers are frozen in controls.json.
controls.meaning: Both candidate and independent reference must agree on each expected gate. Controls do not count as research-input passes.

execution.worker_cap: min(public worker cap, internal deadline-now-1 second evidence reserve); kill entire fresh worker process group on timeout
execution.accounting: Outer monotonic clock begins before directory/input/control generation. Freeze file copies/hashes, prime check, process startup, controls, candidates, references, evidence I/O and sealing all charged. Source authoring/static syntax checks precede this single execution and are not candidate trials.
execution.frozen_files: Runner, candidate, independent reference, expanded protocol, generated full input list and each N-only JSON, expanded controls, H019 complete preregistration, full H017 proof/review, and required project instructions/checkpoint; SHA-256 manifest written before importing either arithmetic implementation
execution.evidence_policy: Exclusive-create evidence directory; refuse existing directory. Append progress logs and exclusive-create witnesses/results. Initial all-unstarted outcomes is atomically checkpointed during this one run. Preserve partial files and statuses if worker dies. Never rerun or modify original frozen source to improve outcomes.
execution.partial_counters: At timeout, retain last flushed stage/counters/times as partial lower observations; incomplete-stage work and further counters are unknown, not zero
execution.implementation_rejection: Any false acceptance or candidate/reference inconsistency rejects the implementation
execution.continuation: All five correct controls AND independently verified certificates on BOTH n=65536 and n=262144. Otherwise inconclusive at this fixed implementation/budget, except implementation rejection above. An individual valid certificate retains its finite count even if overall criterion fails.
execution.postrun: Read existing evidence and write finding only; no new experiment, modified-source rerun, package installation, shared changes, recursive delegation, commit, publication or scheduler. Parent runs shared project checks and commissions independent review.

encodings.huge_integers: Signed Python hex strings, no decimal digit-limit override
encodings.large_product_hash: SHA-256 of minimal unsigned big-endian bytes; zero uses empty bytes; bit_length also stored
encodings.factor_operands: Every equation-11 product stores exact hexadecimal bases and integer exponents; huge fully multiplied products need not be serialized
